The word "ceasefire" has lost all meaning.

One year ago, Israel and Hamas agreed to a supposed truce, only for Israel to
almost instantly and repeatedly violate it with impunity.

It seems to Israel, "ceasefire" means[ killing](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-
in-palestine-israel-kills-dae) children, firing on[ breastfeeding
mothers](https://www.instagram.com/reels/Da4ABkdvo-3/), and blocking the
entrance of meaningful amounts of aid or any reconstruction materials. To
Israel, "ceasefire" means[ killing journalists](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-
in-palestine-israeli-settlers-e73),[ denying](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-
in-palestine-israel-kills-children-kites) children the simple pleasure of
flying kites, and[ striking funeral processions](https://zeteo.com/p/this-
week-in-palestine-israel-attacks-funeral-gaza). To Israel, "ceasefire" means[
killing more than 1,480 Palestinians](https://t.me/MOHMediaGaza/7659) in one
year.

Palestinians cannot mark one year since the so-called "ceasefire" took effect
- because there has been no real ceasefire at all.
